newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 14.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Government faces a week of labour unrest, a strike by civil servants is scheduled for Thursday.

-- Junior budget minister Alain Lamassoure says in an interview that VAT tax may be lowered in the next five years if economic growth reaches 2.5 percent, does not rule out calling off tax rise on fuels if alternative source of revenue is found, adds government has very little room to raise civil servant wages.
-- British Airways and Virgin Express to file competing bids for ailing airline Air Liberte with court today.
